review: The 64-byte continuation at 0x540078..0x5400B8 decodes exactly. Four ordered calculations each use an SDIV of the freshly loaded signed word at R5+36 by 2, which truncates toward zero; the results are combined with the earlier stack values and +/-1 into SP+44, +52, +48, +56. The denominator is fixed nonzero, and the subsequent arithmetic wraps as 32-bit register arithmetic.
limitations: Fresh decode supports the saved read order, stores, and truncation behavior. It is only a continuation within the larger 0x540036..0x5409C4 candidate; full function ABI, bounds, and semantics remain open.
No implementation, admission, or freeze gates.
